Flat bike pedals have a series of studs or pins in different positions across both surfaces of the pedal. Pins are adjustable and are placed to optimize your shoe placement. The wide platform of the flat peddle allows you to exert leverage during cornering and pumping hard while adjusting foot placement to gain control over the bike for different terrains.
